title: Parameterized total restriction weight
statement: For any nonnegative integer $n$ and any real number $\delta$, give each coordinate restriction the weight $\delta$ if it is free and $(1-\delta)/2$ if it is fixed to either $1$ or $-1$. Give an assignment of restrictions to the $n$ coordinates the product of its coordinate weights. The sum over all such assignments is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: δ is an arbitrary real number
